title: A role ARN that matches the caller only if case is ignored
question: Does a role ARN in a Principal element match the caller's role regardless of case? AWS says the user name part of a user ARN is case sensitive, but says nothing about roles. The analyzer refuses.

cases.name: role_name_in_lowercase
cases.description: The bucket policy names role/district/campusapp, and the caller is role/district/CampusApp.

readings.ALLOW: role names in a principal ignore case

cases.name: user_name_in_uppercase_control
cases.description: The bucket policy names user/KWONG, and the caller is user/kwong.

readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: user names are case sensitive, as AWS documents
